questions.q_en:
Select the option that indicates the correct arrangement of the given words in the order in which they appear in an English dictionary.

1- Talisman

2- Tantamount

3- Tangential

4- Tantalizing

5- Taciturn
questions.solution_en:
The first 2 letters of all words is 'Ta'.

2nd letter of 'Talisman' is 'l', 'Tantamount', 'Tangential', and 'Tantalizing' is 'n' and 'Taciturn' is 'c'. Which means 'Taciturn' will be the first word in the dictionary.

Only in option (d), 5th word (Taciturn) is given at first place.

Hence, the correct order of words in the dictionary will be 5, 1, 3, 4, 2

Hence, option (d) is correct.
